title: Wally Wallington builds a Stonehenge in his backyard on his own

tellings.quote: He's he's the dude that uh maybe you've seen his videos before where he erected Stonehinge in his backyard by himself.

plain: Luke Caverns, a researcher of ancient building methods, mentioned Wally Wallington on Jesse Michels's podcast. Caverns says Wallington is the man from the videos who raised a copy of Stonehenge, the ancient ring of giant standing stones in England, in his backyard by himself. He brings it up to show that huge stones can be moved by one person with simple methods.
